SELECT A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, A.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, A.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, A.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, A.CCY ccy, A.VDATE vdate, A.MDATE mdate, A.PROFIT_TYPE profitType,
T1.CUSTOMER_NAME issuer,
A.CALENDAR_ID calendarId,
T2.CUSTOMER_NAME trusteeId,
T.CUSTOMER_NAME manager, A.ISSUE_AMT issueAmt, A.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE capiIncomeFeature, B.TYPE_1 assetType, B.TYPE_6 category, B.TYPE_7 type,
B.TYPE_9 type9, B.TYPE_10 type10, B.TYPE_11 type11, B.TYPE_12 type12, C.PUR_SPEED purSpeed, C.RED_SPEED redSpeed, C.DATA_SOURCE dataSource,
FPR.RECOMMENDER recommender, MCP.COUNTER_NAME recommenderName
,B.TYPE_18 type18 ,C.IS_QTZQ isQtzq ,T8.BASIS basis ,T3.CUSTOMER_NAME financier ,A.update_time as updateTime ,A.update_user as updateUser FROM FIN_PRODUCT A inner join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE B on A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID inner join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C on A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_RECOMMENT FPR ON FPR.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY MCP ON FPR.RECOMMENDER = MCP.COUNTER_ID
LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T ON T.CUSTOMER_ID = A.MANAGER
LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T1 ON T1.CUSTOMER_ID = A.ISSUER LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T2 ON T2.CUSTOMER_ID = A.TRUSTEE_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T3 ON T3.CUSTOMER_ID = A.FINANCIER
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T5 ON T5.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID
AND T5.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND T5.FINPROD_TYPE = #{cashFinprodType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
left join ( select FINPROD_ID, max(eff_date) as EFF_DATE from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE group by FINPROD_ID ) tempT8 on A.FINPROD_ID = tempT8.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T8 ON T8.FINPROD_ID = tempT8.FINPROD_ID AND T8.EFF_DATE = tempT8.EFF_DATE and T8.CASH_ID = T5.CASH_ID WHERE B.TYPE_18 IN ('13') /** 项目类资产**/
AND (A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{finprodMarketId}),'%') OR A.FINPROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{finprodMarketId}),'%') )
AND A.VDATE >= to_date(#{startVDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.VDATE <= to_date(#{endVDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.MDATE >= to_date(#{startMDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND A.MDATE <= to_date(#{endMDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND B.TYPE_1 = #{assetType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO WHERE CUSTOMER_ID = #{custormId}
SELECT FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT COUNT(FINPROD_MARKET_ID) FROM FIN_PRODUCT WHERE FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId}

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, A.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, A.FINPROD_TYPE2, A.FINPROD_TYPE, A.CCY ccy, A.VDATE vdate, A.MDATE mdate, A.ISSUER issuer, A.CALENDAR_ID calendarId, A.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE capiIncomeFeature, A.TRUSTEE_ID trusteeId, A.MANAGER manager, A.ISSUE_AMT issueAmt, A.REMARK remark, A.PROFIT_TYPE profitType, A.BLN_AREA blnArea, B.TYPE_1 assetType, B.TYPE_2 accountintType, B.TYPE_3 taxType, B.TYPE_6 category, B.TYPE_7 type,
B.TYPE_9 type9, B.TYPE_10 type10, B.TYPE_11 type11, B.TYPE_12 type12,
FPR.RECOMMENDER recommender,
C.IS_COMPOUND_INT isCompoundInt,
A.CONTRACT_NO contractNo, C.INVEST_NATURE investNature, C.PUR_SPEED purSpeed, C.RED_SPEED redSpeed
,B.TYPE_18 type18 ,C.IS_QTZQ isQtzq, A.TERM_DAYS termDays, ( CASE WHEN C.PUR_SPEED = 0 THEN '01' WHEN C.PUR_SPEED = 1 THEN '02' WHEN C.PUR_SPEED = 2 THEN '03' ELSE '01' END ) transMode, C.BOND_RISK_TYPE bondRiskType, C.IS_EFF_PLEDGE isEffPledge, A.FINANCIER financier, A.SPONSOR sponsor FROM FIN_PRODUCT A
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_RECOMMENT FPR ON FPR.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID
,FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE B, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD C WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_ID id, MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_NAME text,
MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD.INSITITUTE_CODE col FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD ON MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_ID = MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD.CUSTOMER_ID
( MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_ABBR LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
( MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{initValue}, '%')) OR MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_ABBR LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{initValue}, '%')) OR MST_CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{initValue}, '%')) )

SELECT FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, FINPROD_NAME name, FINPROD_NAME shortName, FINPROD_MARKET_ID hidCode FROM FIN_PRODUCT
B.TYPE_18 IN ('13')
and (FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or FINPROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
AND P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM VAL_VW_MST_HOLIDAY WHERE CDATE = TO_DATE(#{dateStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRADE_CALENDAR_ID = #{calId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND IS_HOLIDAY > 0

SELECT A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, A.FINPROD_NAME shortName FROM FIN_PRODUCT A inner join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE B on A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID where B.TYPE_18 IN ('13') /** 项目类资产**/
and ( A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or A.FINPROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') )
( A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{initValue} OR A.FINPROD_NAME = #{initValue} )
